about: The build v3-launch (2026-10-30) was deployed from, frozen for the ops, indexer and web tests that check v3-launch's facts, since contracts/ now holds v3.2. Creation code, runtime code, immutable positions and ABI of all six contracts: forge's bytecode, deployedBytecode, immutableReferences and abi (the creation code added 2026-11-01 from a rebuild of the same tree, whose runtime code, immutable positions and ABI equal these byte for byte; no contract links a library), from `git archive d21daf3 contracts` (the last commit to change contracts/src, contracts/foundry.toml or contracts/lib before the deploy; the same through main and v3.2's base a8ec6d1) built with that contracts/foundry.toml (solc 0.8.24, evm cancun, optimizer 200 runs, legacy pipeline; forge 1.7.1) and contracts/lib with every submodule initialised, openzeppelin's own included (their remappings are in the metadata hash). Byte-identical to the build v3-launch's verify used, and each contract matches its live code on Base and Bittensor with its immutables masked, metadata hash included. src/ is contracts/src and test/ the three contract tests ops reads v3-launch's calibration from, both as of a8ec6d1 (the gas calibration in AdapterGas.t.sol was raised after d21daf3, before the deploy). Tag v3.1-contracts-reviewed (933aec9) is older: the pre-audit fixes came after it.
